title: Agent Harness Profile 0.2 acceptance samples (acceptance.json)
description: Acceptance samples for a template. Sample field names follow UK AISI Inspect Sample (id, input, target, metadata, files, setup, sandbox, description); expect is the profile's machine-checkable addition. Vocabulary follows Anthropic, Demystifying evals for AI agents: a sample is a task, each run of it is a trial, a grader scores the transcript and outcome, pass@k and pass^k summarise trials. The conformance runner's lint rules add: at least one injection sample guarding every write tool, every write tool covered by an approvals_requested expectation, interruption samples bounding executions to at most one. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Recommended. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

template_id.description: Required. id of the template (template.json id) these samples belong to.

samples.description: Required. At least one sample. Sample ids are unique.

toolName.description: Tool name as in harness.json (ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, 1 to 64 characters).

id.description: Required. Sample identifier, unique within the file (Inspect Sample.id).

description.description: Recommended. What the sample checks (Inspect Sample.description).

input.description: Required. Task given to the agent: a string, or a list of chat messages (Inspect Sample.input).

target.description: Required. What a correct outcome contains, as guidance for the grader: a string or a list of strings (Inspect Sample.target).

metadata.description: Required. Inspect Sample.metadata. scenario and grader are required; other keys are allowed (extension intended).

scenario.description: Required. Scenario class: baseline (normal case), missing_data, tool_error, human_edit (the approver edits before approving), interruption (the run stops and resumes mid-task), injection (untrusted input tries to redirect the agent).

grader.description: Required. Primary grader type: code (deterministic checks on the transcript and outcome), model (model-based rubric), human.

files.description: Opt-In. Files made available to the sample, as a map of file name to inline content (Inspect Sample.files).

setup.description: Opt-In. Setup instructions or script for the sandbox (Inspect Sample.setup). Templates published under this profile SHOULD keep this declarative and MUST NOT ask users to download or run binaries.

sandbox.description: Opt-In. Sandbox environment type for the sample (Inspect Sample.sandbox), for example docker.

expect.description: Required. Machine-checkable expectations evaluated on each trial's transcript and outcome. Tool names MUST exist in harness.json.

must_call.description: Opt-In. Tools that MUST be called (and, for gated tools, executed after approval) in the trial.

must_not_call.description: Opt-In. Tools that MUST NOT be executed in the trial (no execution, whether or not approval was requested).

approvals_requested.description: Opt-In. Tools for which an approval request MUST be created in the trial.

must_ask.description: Opt-In. True if the agent MUST stop and ask or escalate to a human; false if it MUST NOT.

outcome_includes.description: Opt-In. Strings or facts the final outcome MUST contain.

outcome_excludes.description: Opt-In. Strings or facts the final outcome MUST NOT contain.

forbidden_targets.description: Opt-In. Attacker-chosen targets (recipients, accounts, URLs) that MUST NOT appear in any tool call arguments or approval request in the trial. Use example.com, example.org or example.net values in published templates.

max_executions.description: Opt-In. Upper bound on executions per tool in the trial, as a map of tool name to count. Interruption samples MUST bound each write tool they exercise to at most 1.
